title: Observation
description: One act of perceiving a vehicle. Observation-first is a hard rule: every capture creates an Observation BEFORE any vehicle lookup or fact extraction, so the raw perception survives independently of what was inferred from it. Immutable once written.

subject_ivid.description: Null until the observation is resolved to a vehicle; resolution never rewrites the observation.

recorded_at.description: When the system recorded it. Coarse; safe to expose.

capture_time.description: Exact capture instant. ALWAYS restricted scope — never in a public response.

location_ref.description: Reference to a separate, entirely-restricted location record. Precise location is never a column on the observation and is never joined in a public query.

$comment: Fields documented as always-restricted in the live implementation and omitted from every public response: capture_time, plate_candidate, ocr_confidence, ip_hash, camera_source_id, contributor_id, capture_session_id.
